_comment: Corpus boundary, per DECISIONS.md entry 1. The crawl takes the sitemap and applies these rules; anything excluded is recorded in the manifest by name and link so the assistant can answer 'why isn't that in here?'.

exclusion_reasons./products: category pages are boilerplate over the product pages
exclusion_reasons./support/case-studies: no technical content for the question types in scope
exclusion_reasons./support/knowledgebase/how-to-videos: an index of videos; 35 words, no procedures
exclusion_reasons./warmshell-natural-insulation: marketing landing page; the system guides carry the figures
exclusion_reasons./warmshell-natural-insulation/about-warm: duplicate of the landing page as served
exclusion_reasons./warmshell-natural-insulation/warmshell-: marketing; the linked roof design guide is indexed instead

document_link_text._comment: Documents are classified by the text of the link that points at them, never by filename: filenames on this site carry spaces, typos and inconsistent prefixes. Only technical datasheets are indexed.

system_guides._comment: Warmshell system guides carry the thermal figures that product pages do not. Per-product installation guides stay excluded; these three are the stated exception.

authority_rank._comment: Conflict resolution, per DECISIONS.md entry 12. Lower number wins; newest wins within a rank.
